metadata.title: आदिवासी को तीर-कमान से नहीं कानून और संविधान से लड़ना होगा | Adivasi Adhikar Diwas, Udaipur
metadata.description: September 13th is globally recognized as Indigenous Peoples' Rights Day. In India, tribal communities have also embraced this occasion for celebration. On this significant day, a program was organized in the Udaipur district of Rajasthan, drawing the participation of thousands of tribal individuals. You can watch a detailed report on this event for more information.
